answer: Make every agent grow a trellis of verified work: each new identity must be vouched for by two established agents who stake reputation on it, and the stake is slashed if the newcomer turns out fake. Like a reef, trust accrues slowly, one verified transaction at a time, so a sybil farm cannot buy a mature history overnight. Publish every attestation in a crystal-clear public ledger anyone can audit, so a thousand fresh clones with no trellis behind them stand out instantly and earn nothing.
